sample_unit: anonymized patient records (MIMIC-IV-ED) used to generate synthetic German dialogues

links.outcome: Precision, recall and F1 of clinical information extracted from German synthetic emergency dialogues
links.effect: High extraction accuracy, especially medication data (F1 86.21%-100%), but performance declined in nuanced clinical language.
links.quote: Initial results demonstrated high extraction accuracy, particularly in medication data (F1-scores: 86.21%-100%), though performance declined in nuanced clinical language, requiring further refinement for real-world emergency settings.

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an automated pipeline using RAG to extract emergency medical documentation from synthetic German dialogues generated from MIMIC-IV-ED records. It evaluates model/pipeline accuracy but does not compare outcomes with vs without an organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
